reuse.why: The new action reuses the existing category selector, amount conversion, month utilities, budget writer, batching, and undo registration.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain shared, but five actions repeat the same category-loading query and its extended row type.

placement.why: Selection policy stays in month-budget-categories.ts, database access and orchestration stay in actions.ts, and method registration stays in app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared policy, registration, and tests.

maintainability.why: The central policy is straightforward, but repeated query contracts and copyPreviousMonth's inconsistent exposure of the shared hidden-category option need cleanup.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions call categoriesForMonthBudgetAction, and setLastMonthSpending also calls amountForAverageBudget.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category queries and row types in actions.ts are explicit copies rather than disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: categoriesForMonthBudgetAction replaces the action discriminator with the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and its hidden-check override; template and fixed-group exclusions remain shared without action-specific exceptions.
